name: agentsearch-mcp
description: AgentSearch web search and optional page extract over MCP stdio (direct API or Pocket portal).
long_description:
MCP server for [AgentSearch](https://agentsearchhq.com) web search.

- `agentsearch_web_search` searches via a local AgentSearch API (`direct`) or the Pocket Network agent portal (`portal`).
- `agentsearch_extract` fetches page content from `POST /v1/extract` in direct mode.

Configure the mode, base URL, and optional API key at install time. Defaults match a local server at `http://127.0.0.1:8000`.

tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web via AgentSearch. Uses AGENTSEARCH_MODE=direct (local API) or portal (Pocket). Returns structured JSON results.

tools.name: agentsearch_extract
tools.description: Extract page content from a URL via AgentSearch POST /v1/extract (direct mode only).

agentsearchMode.title: Mode
agentsearchMode.description: direct talks to a local AgentSearch API. portal uses the Pocket Network agent portal.

agentsearchBaseUrl.title: Base URL
agentsearchBaseUrl.description: Base URL for direct mode. No trailing slash. Ignored for search when mode is portal.

agentsearchApiKey.title: API key
agentsearchApiKey.description: Optional Bearer token for direct mode. Leave blank if the API does not require one.
